openRoles.title: Senior MEP Maintenance Engineer
openRoles.description: Manage day-to-day electrical systems, chillers, and diesel generator networks in a premium corporate commercial park. Experience in corporate facility operations required.

openRoles.title: Senior Facility Manager

openRoles.title: Assistant Security Officer (ASO)
openRoles.description: Audit gate entry logs, manage patrol rotations, and train fire marshal teams under guidelines set by the Director of Security. Ex-servicemen or security diplomates preferred.
